key.name: pinned-apps
key.description: Desktop-file IDs of pinned applications, in display order, for example "org.gnome.Nautilus.desktop". Entries that are not installed are kept and shown as unavailable.

key.name: icon-size
key.description: Icon size in pixels, from 32 to 64.

key.name: autohide
key.description: Hide the dock until the pointer reaches its screen edge or a keyboard focus enters it.

key.name: magnification
key.description: Enlarge dock icons near the pointer, up to 1.5 times. Has no effect when GNOME animations are disabled.

key.name: position
key.description: Screen edge the dock sits on: bottom, left or right.
